sources.quote: Cached tokens are billed at the **cached prompt token price**, which is substantially lower than the regular prompt token price. The exact rates vary by model — check the [Pricing](/developers/pricing) page for current prices.
sources.supports: xAI documents a distinct reduced rate for cached prompt tokens but gives no historical grok-3-mini price or cache-write price here.

sources.supports: An archived official xAI model document references grok-3-mini, but the captured passage provides no pricing evidence.

notes: The available provider documentation does not establish whether $0.50 per million cache-write tokens was ever xAI's official grok-3-mini rate, nor state a price-change date.
